g.text: Calibration curves show raw and grouped out-of-fold recalibrated transport predictions. Decision curves use raw transported probabilities. Bands show patient- or patient-safe hospital-cluster bootstrap intervals.
Within-model raw vs OOF-recalibrated comparisons are primary; all models used the same five-class target before four-class collapse.
